# costgraph_current_organization (Data Source)

Read the organization identity associated with the configured API key. This lookup does not grant organization-wide management permissions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "costgraph_current_organization" "current" {}

output "organization_id" {
  value = data.costgraph_current_organization.current.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Organization UUID.
- `name` (String) Organization name.
- `slug` (String) Organization slug.
